differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Mildly elevated creatinine with overweight, low HDL and stress suggests early hypertension‑related kidney injury.

differential.name: NSAID‑induced analgesic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Chronic neck and generalized pain raise likelihood of regular NSAID use causing renal tubular injury and anemia.

differential.name: Early diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Prediabetes, metabolic syndrome features, and borderline renal dysfunction point toward incipient diabetic kidney disease.

differential.name: IgA nephropathy
differential.rationale: Asian ethnicity and isolated creatinine rise without overt hypertension raise suspicion for primary glomerulonephritis.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Persistent stress, chronic pain, atopic dermatitis and possible low‑grade inflammation can produce mild anemia accompanying renal impairment.
